data.title: Blossom windows, early garden access, and slower dinners
data.intro: Cherry season changes the rhythm of the entire city. These packages shift the timing, add garden reservations, and build in the kaiseki evening pace that spring deserves.

data.title: Book garden districts before midday and let the evening become ritual, not transit
data.body: Maruyama Park at peak blossom needs an early start. By 8am it’s quiet; by 10am you’re sharing it with half of Kyoto. The kaiseki evening pacing more than compensates.

data.title: Cherry blossom timing with quiet morning routes
data.summary: Shifts temple visits to first light, adds garden reservations at Shinjuan and Daisen-in, and layers in an evening kaiseki dinner progression.
